items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: The transcript mentions Flip Wilson only in the context of Monty Kaye being his executive producer; the interviewee (John Simmons) does not mention any personal interaction or relationship with Flip Wilson.

ctx.x: you're something else. So no sooner we get back home before we could get to work, she had to go into her act. And I showed her this whip when I walked in, just like you show a dog or a cat, you know where he had piddled on the floor, you know, I showed her this whip and I hung it on the door knob. I'm tired of using my hands. And I caught her with this whip. She wanted to jump out the fourth floor. I hit her every where but in her face and the bottom of her feet.

And Monty Kaye, who's executive producer for Flip Wilson, he was running around, running errands for Billy and waking her up for interviews and for different things so he got an apartment next door --
